sources.publisher: 北京市文物局 (Beijing Municipal Cultural Heritage Bureau)
sources.usage: 清华园车站旧址 designated as the 9th batch of Beijing Municipal Cultural Heritage Protection Units (published 2023-01-19); built 1910, station name calligraphed by Zhan Tianyou (詹天佑), the first stop of the 1949 '进京赶考'. Supports cultural-narrative (agent.5) and heritage-constraint design.
sources.limitation: Heritage protection scope and construction-control zone must follow official heritage data; this proposal uses only the published protection-level fact and a directional location, not a statutory heritage line.

sources.publisher: 北京市文物局 / 国家文物局
sources.usage: 大钟寺(觉生寺) is a 4th-batch National Key Cultural Heritage Protection Unit (1996), now the Great Bell Temple Museum; supports Dazhongsi key-area cultural positioning and the fact that Dazhongsi is one of Haidian's two official AI-innovation-block pilot areas.
sources.limitation: Heritage control follows official data; only the protection-level fact is cited.

sources.publisher: 北京市科学技术委员会 (Beijing Municipal S&T Commission) / 中关村科学城
sources.usage: Haidian AI core industry scale 282.2 billion yuan (2024, +30% YoY, ~80% of Beijing); ~1900 AI enterprises; 95 filed large models; city's first 10^16-FLOP (万P) intelligent-computing cluster. Supports AI innovation ecosystem (agent.2) industry grounding.
sources.limitation: Aggregate official statistics, not spatial data; two enterprise-count calibers coexist (1300+ vs 1900+); cited with year. Not an investment or recruitment commitment.

sources.publisher: 国际科技创新中心 (ncsti.gov.cn) / 中关村科学城
sources.usage: 中关村人工智能大模型产业集聚区 core area ~9.5 km² (east: 学院路, south: 知春路, west: 万泉河路, north: 清华西路-清华东路), inaugurated 2023-09-15, with 五道口/北大西门/中关村西区/清华科技园 as first-batch parks. This core area overlaps the proposal's overall design scope — the strongest planning anchor.
sources.limitation: Official planning fact, not statutory boundary; used to ground the spatial logic, not as an official redline.

sources.publisher: 海淀区统计局 (Haidian District Bureau of Statistics)
sources.usage: Haidian GDP 1369.14 billion yuan (2025, +7.2%), 311.1万 residents; 92 national key labs (63.4% of Beijing, 17.9% of China), 51 unicorns, technology-contract turnover 380.69 billion yuan. Supports coordinated-research-area industry and talent grounding.
sources.limitation: Aggregate official statistics; not spatial or enterprise-specific data.

sources.publisher: 北京市发改委 (Beijing Municipal NDRC) / 科技日报
sources.usage: 京张铁路遗址公园 built on the original Jingzhang surface tracks (after the Beijing-Zhangjiakou HSR went underground inside the 5th Ring Road via the Qinghuayuan tunnel); full length ~9 km (South Xizhimen/Beijing North — North 5th Ring); Phase 2 opened 2026-08-06, total site ~53 ha, serving 70 communities / ~450k residents. Supports heritage-park spine (agent.4/agent.5).
sources.limitation: Two area calibers (70ha 2024 planning vs 53ha 2026 built); cited with year. Length/area are official public facts, not this proposal's computed boundary.
